rationale: M59 (#825). Lines read off the fixture's own text; the pre-fix values are MEASURED by running this same fixture through the HEAD worktree's analyzer (all 8 relationships reported no line). svelte's template expressions are opaque `svelte_raw_text` leaves, so the identifier walk is a pure-string scan — and the collector kept a Set of names, which discards the fragment the name was read out of. Three contracts are pinned: a component usage's line is its TAG (23), an event directive's handler line is the directive's expression (24), and a template read's line is the fragment it was read from (24 `{count}`, 26 `{label}`). One edge per name is pre-existing behaviour (the same name read twice emits one `uses`); its line is one of the occurrences and is verified to be a line the name is written on. The prop's containment line is the `$props()` destructure's own line (14), and the import edge is a FILE line (12) because the delegated script's lines are shifted by the merge.
